properties.answer: Keep only the diagrams and mockups that something in the design actually points at. The link is the filter — the store holds what someone will look at again, not every intermediate render. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “What a session PRODUCES is captured too — diagrams, mockups and rendered explanations, not just the decisions distilled from them”
properties.question: Diagrams and mock-ups an assistant makes during a session are usually thrown away, even though they are often the clearest picture of what was agreed. Should reflow2 keep them automatically — and if so, all of them, or only the ones a decision actually points at?
